# Favze

> Favze Digital Marketing is an affordable full-service agency with custom packages tailored to your needs. Northern Indiana & Michiana's affordable full-service local digital marketing agency focused on helping businesses become their customer’s favorite local business.

Favze Digital Marketing (Favze, LLC) is based in Middlebury, Indiana, and serves businesses across Northern Indiana and Southwest Michigan (Michiana). Founder and CEO: Riley Catalano (https://rileycatalano.com, https://www.linkedin.com/in/rileycatalano/). Phone and text: 574-747-5012. Email: riley@favze.com.

## Glossary Term Guides
- [What Is a Google Business Profile? A Local Business Guide](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/google-business-profile): Learn what a Google Business Profile is, how it ranks in Google Maps, and the steps Northern Indiana and Michiana businesses take to turn their profile into calls.
- [What Is the Google Local Pack? How the Map Pack Works](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/local-pack): The local pack is the map and three business listings at the top of local Google searches. Learn how it ranks businesses and how to earn a spot in Northern Indiana.
- [What Is NAP Consistency? Name, Address, Phone for Local SEO](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/nap): NAP stands for name, address, and phone number. Learn why consistent NAP details help Google trust your location and how local businesses keep them accurate.
- [What Is Schema Markup? A Plain-English Guide for Local Businesses](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/schema-markup): Schema markup is code that labels your business details for search engines and AI. Learn the schema types local businesses use and how it helps rich results and AI answers.
- [What Is Structured Data? How Search Engines Read Your Site](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/structured-data): Structured data organizes information in a format machines understand. See how it differs from schema markup and how local businesses use it for search and AI visibility.
- [What Is E-E-A-T? Experience, Expertise, Authority, and Trust](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/e-e-a-t): E-E-A-T describes the qualities Google looks for in helpful content. Learn what each letter means and how local businesses show experience and trust on their websites.
- [What Are Core Web Vitals? Page Speed Metrics Explained](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/core-web-vitals): Core Web Vitals are Google's measurements of loading, responsiveness, and visual stability. Learn LCP, INP, and CLS, their targets, and how faster sites win more customers.
- [What Are Google AI Overviews? How They Pick Sources](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/ai-overviews): AI Overviews are AI-written summaries at the top of some Google searches. Learn how they choose sources and how local businesses earn citations inside them.
- [What Is a Backlink? How Links Build Local Authority](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/backlink): A backlink is a link from another website to yours. Learn why quality links matter, which local links help most, and how Northern Indiana businesses earn them.
- [What Is Search Intent? Matching Pages to What People Want](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/search-intent): Search intent is the reason behind a search: to learn, compare, buy, or visit. Learn the four intent types and how local businesses match content to each one.
- [What Is On-Page SEO? A Practical Guide for Local Businesses](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/on-page-seo): On-page SEO is everything you improve on a page to help it rank: content, headings, titles, links, and images. Learn the essentials for Northern Indiana businesses.
- [What Is a Title Tag? How to Write Titles That Earn Clicks](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/title-tag): A title tag is the clickable headline for your page in search results. Learn how to write title tags that rank, earn clicks, and name the towns you serve.
- [What Is a Meta Description? Writing Snippets That Get Clicks](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/meta-description): A meta description is the short summary under your title in search results. Learn how to write meta descriptions that earn clicks for Michiana businesses.
- [What Is an Internal Link? How Linking Your Pages Helps SEO](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/internal-link): Internal links connect pages on your own website. Learn how they guide visitors, spread authority, and help Google understand your services and service areas.
- [What Is Anchor Text? How Link Words Shape SEO](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/anchor-text): Anchor text is the clickable wording of a link. Learn how descriptive anchor text helps visitors and search engines and which anchor types local businesses use.
- [What Is a Canonical URL? Preventing Duplicate Content](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/canonical-url): A canonical URL tells search engines which version of a page is the main one. Learn how canonical tags prevent duplicate content and consolidate ranking signals.
- [What Is robots.txt? Controlling How Search Engines Crawl](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/robots-txt): robots.txt is a file that tells search engine and AI crawlers which parts of your site to crawl. Learn how it works and the settings local businesses use.
- [What Is an XML Sitemap? Helping Google Find Every Page](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/sitemap): An XML sitemap lists the pages you want search engines to crawl and index. Learn how sitemaps work and how to submit one in Google Search Console.
- [What Is Alt Text? Image Descriptions for SEO and Accessibility](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/alt-text): Alt text describes an image in words for screen readers and search engines. Learn how to write helpful alt text that improves accessibility and image search.
- [What Is a Zero-Click Search? Winning Visibility Without the Click](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/zero-click-search): A zero-click search ends on the results page without a website visit. Learn why zero-click searches are growing and how local businesses still win calls and trust.
- [What Is Conversion Tracking? Measuring Calls, Forms, and Sales](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/conversion-tracking): Conversion tracking records the actions that matter, such as calls, form fills, and bookings. Learn how local businesses set it up and use it to grow.
- [What Is Google Ads Quality Score? How to Raise It](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/quality-score): Quality Score is Google Ads' 1 to 10 rating of your keywords, ads, and landing pages. Learn what shapes it and how a higher score lowers your cost per click.
- [What Is Smart Bidding? Google Ads Automated Bid Strategies](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/smart-bidding): Smart Bidding uses machine learning to set Google Ads bids for each auction based on conversion goals. Learn the strategies and when local businesses should use them.
- [What Are Responsive Search Ads? Writing Google Ads That Adapt](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/responsive-search-ads): Responsive search ads combine up to 15 headlines and 4 descriptions to match each search. Learn how they work and how local businesses write strong assets.
- [What Are Google Local Services Ads? Pay-Per-Lead Explained](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/local-services-ads): Google Local Services Ads place verified local businesses at the top of search with a Google badge, charging per lead. Learn how they work and who qualifies.
- [What Is Performance Max? Google's All-in-One Campaign Type](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/performance-max): Performance Max is a Google Ads campaign that runs across Search, Maps, YouTube, Display, Gmail, and Discover from one setup. Learn how it works for local businesses.
- [What Is Remarketing? Reconnecting With Past Website Visitors](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/remarketing): Remarketing shows ads to people who already visited your website or engaged with your business. Learn how it works on Google and Meta and how to use it well.
- [What Is Call Tracking? Connecting Phone Calls to Marketing](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/call-tracking): Call tracking uses unique phone numbers to show which ads, pages, and campaigns make your phone ring. Learn how local businesses use it to measure real leads.
- [What Are UTM Parameters? Tracking Every Link You Share](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/utm-parameters): UTM parameters are tags added to links that tell analytics where visitors came from. Learn the five UTM tags and how local businesses use them to measure campaigns.
- [What Is Lead Scoring? Prioritizing Your Best Leads](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/lead-scoring): Lead scoring assigns points to leads based on fit and behavior so your team follows up with the most promising prospects first. Learn how to build a simple model.
- [What Is Lead Nurturing? Turning Interested Leads Into Customers](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/lead-nurturing): Lead nurturing builds relationships with leads who are not ready to buy yet, through helpful emails, texts, and content. Learn how local businesses nurture leads.
- [What Is a Drip Campaign? Automated Emails That Build Trust](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/drip-campaign): A drip campaign is a series of automated emails sent on a schedule or after a trigger. Learn the types of drip campaigns and how local businesses use them.
- [What Is Double Opt-In? Confirmed Email Subscriptions Explained](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/double-opt-in): Double opt-in asks new subscribers to confirm their email address before joining your list. Learn the benefits for deliverability and list quality.
- [What Is Email Deliverability? Reaching the Inbox Every Time](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/deliverability): Email deliverability is your ability to land in inboxes instead of spam. Learn what shapes it and how local businesses keep their emails reaching customers.
- [What Are SPF, DKIM, and DMARC? Email Authentication Explained](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/spf-dkim-dmarc): SPF, DKIM, and DMARC are email authentication records that prove your emails are really from you. Learn what each one does and why Gmail and Yahoo require them.
- [What Is Sender Reputation? How Inboxes Judge Your Email](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/sender-reputation): Sender reputation is the trust score inbox providers give your domain and sending IP. Learn what raises it and how local businesses protect it.
- [What Is Audience Segmentation? Sending the Right Message to Each Group](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/segmentation): Segmentation divides your audience into groups with shared traits so each one gets relevant messages. Learn the main segment types and how local businesses use them.
- [What Is a Call to Action? Writing CTAs That Get Results](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/call-to-action): A call to action tells visitors exactly what to do next, such as call, book, or get a quote. Learn how to write and place CTAs that turn visitors into customers.
- [What Is an AI Citation? Getting Recommended by AI Tools](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/ai-citation): An AI citation is when ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or Google AI Overviews references your business or website. Learn how local businesses earn AI citations.
- [What Is Entity SEO? Helping Google Understand Your Business](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/entity-seo): Entity SEO helps search engines and AI recognize your business as a distinct, trusted entity with clear facts and connections. Learn how local businesses build it.
- [What Is llms.txt? A Guide File for AI Tools](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/llms-txt): llms.txt is a proposed file that gives AI tools a clean summary of your website and its most important pages. Learn what it does and how local businesses use it.
- [What Is Google Search Console? A Free SEO Tool Explained](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/google-search-console): Google Search Console is a free tool that shows how your site performs in Google search. Learn the key reports and how local businesses use them to grow.
- [What Is a Buyer Persona? Understanding Your Ideal Customer](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/buyer-persona): A buyer persona is a research-based profile of your ideal customer. Learn how local businesses build personas and use them to guide messaging and marketing.
- [What Is a Long-Tail Keyword? Finding Searches Ready to Buy](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/long-tail-keyword): Long-tail keywords are longer, specific search phrases with clear intent. Learn why they convert well and how local businesses find and target them.
- [What Is Topical Authority? Becoming the Go-To Source](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/topical-authority): Topical authority is the trust search engines and AI give a site that covers a subject thoroughly. Learn how local businesses build it with connected content.
- [What Is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)? AI Grounded in Sources](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-terms/retrieval-augmented-generation): Retrieval-augmented generation is an AI method that looks up relevant documents before writing an answer. Learn how RAG works and why it matters for AI search visibility.
- [What Is Review Velocity? Why Steady Reviews Win Local Search](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-kpis/review-velocity): Review velocity is the pace at which your business earns new reviews. Learn why steady, recent reviews matter for local rankings and customer trust.
- [What Is Click-Through Rate (CTR)? How to Calculate and Improve It](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-kpis/click-through-rate): Click-through rate is the percentage of people who click after seeing your ad, listing, or email. Learn how to calculate CTR and improve it across channels.
- [What Is Conversion Rate? How to Calculate and Improve It](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-kpis/conversion-rate): Conversion rate is the percentage of visitors who take a desired action, such as calling or booking. Learn how to calculate it and raise it for your business.
- [What Is Cost Per Lead (CPL)? How to Calculate and Lower It](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-kpis/cost-per-lead): Cost per lead is how much you spend to generate one new lead. Learn how to calculate CPL, what shapes it, and how local businesses lower it.
- [What Is Cost Per Click (CPC)? How Ad Pricing Works](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-kpis/cost-per-click): Cost per click is the amount you pay each time someone clicks your ad. Learn how CPC is set in Google and Meta auctions and how local businesses lower it.
- [What Is Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)? A Practical Guide](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-kpis/customer-acquisition-cost): Customer acquisition cost is the total cost of winning one new customer. Learn how to calculate CAC and how local businesses use it to guide growth.
- [What Is Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)? How to Calculate It](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-kpis/customer-lifetime-value): Customer lifetime value is the total revenue or profit a customer brings over the whole relationship. Learn how to calculate CLV and use it to guide marketing.
- [What Is Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)? How to Calculate It](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-kpis/return-on-ad-spend): Return on ad spend measures the revenue earned for every dollar spent on ads. Learn how to calculate ROAS, set targets, and improve it.
- [What Is Marketing ROI? How to Measure Return on Investment](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/marketing-kpis/return-on-investment): Return on investment compares the profit from marketing with what it cost. Learn how to calculate marketing ROI and use it to make confident decisions.
- [What Is a Large Language Model (LLM)? A Plain-English Guide](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/ai/large-language-model): A large language model is an AI system trained on vast amounts of text to understand and generate language. Learn how LLMs work and what they mean for local businesses.
- [What Is Generative AI? How It Creates Content for Businesses](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/ai/generative-ai): Generative AI creates new text, images, audio, video, and code from patterns it learned. Learn how local businesses use it responsibly in marketing.
- [What Is an AI Agent? Automation That Plans and Acts](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/ai/ai-agent): An AI agent can plan and take actions toward a goal, such as researching, updating a CRM, or scheduling. Learn how AI agents work and where they help local businesses.
- [What Are AI Hallucinations? Why AI Gets Facts Wrong](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/ai/ai-hallucinations): AI hallucinations happen when AI tools state false information confidently. Learn why they happen, how to catch them, and how to protect your business details.
- [What Is Prompt Engineering? Getting Better Results From AI](https://favze.com/resources/glossary/ai/prompt-engineering): Prompt engineering is the skill of writing clear instructions so AI tools produce accurate, useful, on-brand results. Learn simple techniques for business use.
